decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is distant from the firm's core and still highly uncertain, but the option costs little to keep while its potential value remains unresolved.
Medical examination lighting builds on the firm's established capabilities but targets an unfamiliar market, so moderate uncertainty and keeping costs make it a valuable option to hold.
Industrial explosion-proof luminaires closely align with the firm's core industrial lighting and have lower uncertainty, so there is little reason to abandon this option yet.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product close to the established offer, so uncertainty is very low and it should remain on the market.
